notes.title: Development Update September 2025
notes.content:
Hello all, it's been a busy few weeks. I'm happy to report that all boss characters are finished and I've now moved onto putting some puzzles together to give you a break from all the horror. I'm balancing this with giving our main character a sprucing up. Excited to show you this in the next updated. Thanks for your support. Here's some more boss art (spoilers!). Can you figure out what British folklore inspired this character?

[spoiler]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021673/109dee46a929aebe623ff2f179696aa4249ad52c.png[/img]

[/spoilers]
